3. Scope of Work and Deliverables:
**3. Scope of Work and Deliverables**

Our proposed solution encompasses a comprehensive and methodical approach, ensuring a seamless journey from discovery to deployment for your Data-Lake/Data-Lakehouse platform. Each phase is designed for value delivery, robust integration, and future scalability:

1. **Requirements Gathering and Analysis**  
   We will initiate the project with collaborative discovery sessions involving your key stakeholders, business analysts, and technical teams. This phase will unearth business objectives, existing data sources, reporting requirements, compliance constraints, and future scalability needs. Detailed business and technical requirement documents, workflow diagrams, and data mappings will be delivered to guide subsequent implementation phases.

2. **Data-Lake / Data-Lakehouse Architecture Design**  
   Leveraging insights from the analysis, our architects will design a tailored Data-Lake or Data-Lakehouse architecture optimized for your existing and anticipated data volumes, variety, and velocity. This includes selecting optimal storage formats (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake), specifying lake zones (raw, curated, trusted), schema management strategies, and outlining seamless integration points for downstream analytics and machine learning services.

3. **Infrastructure Setup**  
   We will provision and configure secure, scalable cloud (or hybrid, as appropriate) infrastructure resources necessary for the Data-Lake/Data-Lakehouse environment. This setups include compute instances, storage buckets, networking and connectivity, access control policies, and resource monitoring solutions. Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) templates will be delivered to enable transparent, repeatable deployments.

4. **Data Ingestion and Integration (Batch and Real-Time)**  
   Using a combination of ETL/ELT pipelines and streaming data frameworks, our team will develop robust connectors for all identified data sources. Batch ingestion will be handled via scheduled jobs, while real-time data streams (e.g., via Apache Kafka or cloud-native equivalents) will ensure rapid capture of high-velocity data. Integration workflows will be developed to handle diverse data types, ensuring reliability and near-zero data loss.

5. **Data Processing and Transformation**  
   Comprehensive data processing pipelines will be implemented for cleansing, deduplication, normalization, and enrichment. Transformation logic will be modular, leveraging SQL, Python, or Spark-based engines, depending on use case, to support business logic and analytic model requirements. All processing jobs will be versioned and auditable.

6. **Data Storage and Management**  
   The platform will organize and secure all ingested and processed data using a layered storage structure with defined access controls. Lifecycle policies will be set to manage data retention and archival. Metadata catalogs (such as AWS Glue or Azure Data Catalog) will be configured to maintain discoverability, enforce schema consistency, and support data lineage tracking.

7. **Data Governance and Compliance**  
   A data governance framework will be established with role-based access controls, encryption in-transit and at-rest, data masking for sensitive elements, and audit trails to monitor access and modifications. Policy templates and compliance checklists (GDPR, HIPAA, or as applicable) will be delivered. Integration with existing compliance workflows or regulatory reporting requirements will be ensured.

8. **Analytics, Reporting, and Machine Learning Models Setup**  
   The platform will include ready-to-use zones and environments for business analytics, self-service reporting, and model development. We will integrate preferred BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and provision managed or custom ML environments. Proof-of-concept analytical dashboards and a set of curated, reusable data products will be delivered, alongside sample ML pipelines to demonstrate the platform’s advanced capabilities.

9. **Testing and Validation**  
   Rigorous functional, performance, and security testing will be performed at each critical stage. Automated test scripts and validation checklists will be delivered. User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plans will be executed in collaboration with your business teams to ensure solutions are aligned with requirements and operational standards before go-live.

10. **Documentation and Training**  
    Comprehensive documentation covering architecture, data flows, operational procedures, security policies, and troubleshooting guides will be created and maintained using collaborative tools (e.g., Confluence, SharePoint). Our solution includes targeted training workshops and hands-on sessions for platform administrators, data stewards, data scientists, and business users to maximize knowledge transfer and adoption.

**Deliverables:**  
At each milestone, you will receive clearly defined deliverables, including but not limited to: detailed requirements documents, architecture blueprints, infrastructure deployment scripts, source code repositories for ingestion and processing pipelines, data catalogs, security policies, compliance checklists, analytical dashboards, validation test reports, and user training materials.

This precise and outcome-driven scope of work will position your organization to unlock actionable insights, streamline governance, and accelerate time-to-value with a modern, scalable Data-Lake/Data-Lakehouse solution.

3.2 Data Lake / Lakehouse Architecture D:
**3.2 Data Lake / Lakehouse Architecture Design**

To enable advanced analytics, scalable storage, and robust data governance, we propose a Data Lakehouse architecture on Azure that unifies raw and processed data into a logically layered, governed framework. This solution ensures seamless data ingestion, transformation, curation, and analytical readiness, leveraging Azure’s modern data services for maximum performance, agility, and security.

**Data Lake/Lakehouse Structure**

1. **Raw Data Zone (Landing Zone):**
   - **Purpose:** Serves as the initial repository for all ingested data, including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured formats from disparate sources—operational databases, external APIs, IoT devices, logs, and more.
   - **Implementation:** Data will be ingested and stored in Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) Gen2 using a highly organized folder structure by source, ingestion date/time, and domain.
   - **Integration:** Azure Data Factory pipelines automate the extraction and secure loading of data into this zone, preserving data fidelity and providing auditability.

2. **Cleansed Data Zone (Standardization Zone):**
   - **Purpose:** Facilitates data transformation, standardization, and quality enforcement. Here, raw data is parsed, cleansed (invalid entries removed, typing enforced, de-duplication performed), and conformed to a unified data schema.
   - **Implementation:** Azure Databricks performs scalable, distributed transformations, leveraging Spark-based notebooks and jobs. Data dictionaries and business rules defined in Azure Purview are referenced to standardize datasets.
   - **Output:** Data is written back to ADLS, maintaining lineage and retaining version history for traceability.

3. **Curated Data Zone (Business-Ready Zone):**
   - **Purpose:** Models and aggregates domain-specific, trustworthy datasets optimized for enterprise consumption—reporting, analytics, and data science initiatives.
   - **Implementation:** Processed datasets are selectively surfaced into logical folders by subject area (e.g., Sales, Inventory, Customer, Finance).
   - **Security:** Data access is tightly controlled via Azure role-based access policies, with tags and classifications inherited from Azure Purview.

**Subject Area Data Marts**

To support high-performance analytics and self-service BI, subject area Data Marts are provisioned within Azure Synapse Analytics:

- **Design:** Each Data Mart reflects a defined analytical domain (such as Sales or Customer Analytics), modeled as dedicated schemas or dedicated Synapse serverless SQL pools.
- **Population:** Data movement from the curated zone to Data Marts is orchestrated via Azure Data Factory, with transformation pipelines defined in Databricks.
- **Consumption:** Data Marts are optimized for query performance and support advanced reporting tools, ad hoc queries, and AI/ML workloads.

**Tools and Technologies Integration**

- **Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS):** The multi-zone data lake ensures scalable, cost-effective storage for all data states—raw to curated.
- **Azure Databricks:** Delivers high-performance distributed data engineering, process automation, and machine learning workflows throughout all data zones.
- **Azure Synapse Analytics:** Serves as the cloud data warehouse for Data Marts, enabling robust analytics and data sharing with enterprise tools.
- **Azure Data Factory:** Provides end-to-end, low-code data integration and movement orchestration across systems, ensuring data pipeline reliability and monitoring.
- **Azure Purview:** Embeds automated data discovery, lineage tracing, and unified governance across all layers, enforcing compliance and stewardship policies.

**Deliverable: Detailed Data Architecture Design Document**

The resulting Data Architecture Design Document will detail:

- Logical and physical architecture diagrams depicting zone segmentation, access flows, and service integrations.
- Data pipeline specifications for each ingestion, transformation, and curation process.
- Data security, access control, and governance strategies mapped to Azure services.
- Data Mart logical schema definitions, refresh policies, and integration points for analytics.
- Best practices for scalability, resilience, and future extensibility.

This architecture empowers your organization with an industrial-strength, future-ready data platform: providing fast, secure access to reliable data, accelerating insight generation, and supporting evolving data-driven strategies.
3.3 Infrastructure Setup on Azure:
**3.3 Infrastructure Setup on Azure**

To establish a robust and scalable analytics platform, we will provision and configure a secure Azure infrastructure tailored to your organization’s architecture and compliance standards. Our approach ensures each component is deployed with security, performance, and maintainability in mind.

**Resource Provisioning**

We will provision an **Azure Databricks workspace** within your designated Azure subscription and region, applying best practices for workspace isolation and access controls. This environment will be optimized to support large-scale data engineering and advanced analytics workloads, with cluster policies aligned to your usage and cost management strategies.

An **Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) Gen2** account will be created and configured as the principal data lake, serving as a high-throughput, secure repository for structured and unstructured data. We will enforce hierarchical namespace, enable soft delete policies, and configure access tiers to optimize storage costs. Role-based access and integration with Azure Active Directory (AAD) will ensure secure, granular access control.

For downstream analytics, we will provision an **Azure Synapse Analytics workspace**. This will be configured to leverage both on-demand and dedicated SQL pools, supporting scalable data exploration and reporting. Synapse workspace will be tightly integrated with Databricks and ADLS to enable seamless data movement and advanced analytics pipelines.

**Network Configuration**

To safeguard data-in-transit and ensure secure connectivity between components, a dedicated **Azure Virtual Network (VNet)** will be established as the foundation for all compute and storage services. Subnets will be defined for Databricks, Synapse, and supporting integrations, with appropriate address segmentation for future scalability.

We will create and apply **Network Security Groups (NSGs)** to control and monitor inbound and outbound network traffic on these subnets. Rules will be designed to permit only necessary communication paths—such as allowing Databricks clusters to access ADLS and Synapse over trusted, internal routes—while blocking public internet exposure.

For enhanced security, we will implement **Private Endpoints** for ADLS and Synapse, enabling resources to be accessed entirely over the private network without routing traffic over the public internet. DNS configuration will be managed to ensure seamless connection via private endpoints, and access policies will be aligned with your organization’s compliance mandates.

**Deliverable**

Upon completion, we will validate the environment setup against architectural design and industry best practices. Our deliverable will include comprehensive documentation of all configurations, as well as an environment setup sign-off package. This ensures all stakeholders have confidence in the integrity, security, and readiness of the Azure infrastructure to support your analytics initiatives.
3.4 Data Ingestion and Integration:
To ensure a robust foundation for data-driven decision-making, our solution for **Data Ingestion and Integration** is designed to efficiently capture, process, and harmonize data from diverse sources, aligning with the client's operational and analytical needs.

**Data Ingestion Pipelines**

We will implement a two-pronged approach to data ingestion, combining both batch and real-time methodologies for maximum flexibility and responsiveness:

- **Batch Data Ingestion with Azure Data Factory:** Using Azure Data Factory, we will orchestrate scheduled ingestion workflows, enabling the extraction of large data sets from relational databases, file stores (on-premises and cloud), and third-party APIs. The pipelines will leverage Data Factory’s mapping data flows, facilitating seamless movement and transformation of raw data into centralized data lakes or data warehouses. Automated monitoring and alerting will be configured to ensure high reliability and traceability.

- **Real-time Data Ingestion with Azure Event Hubs and Stream Analytics:** For streaming scenarios—such as telemetry, IoT devices, logs, or transactional systems—data will be captured in real time through Azure Event Hubs. Event streams will be processed on the fly using Azure Stream Analytics, enabling immediate validation, enrichment, and anomaly detection as data arrives. Processed messages will land in downstream storage or analytical platforms in near-real time, supporting latency-sensitive applications and analytics.

**Data Integration, Processing, and Transformation**

We will develop end-to-end ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) and ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) pipelines that integrate disparate data assets into a unified, high-quality dataset:

- **ETL/ELT Pipeline Design and Optimization:** Our solution leverages Azure Data Factory for orchestrating and managing complex data flows, ensuring modularity, scalability, and reusability. The pipelines will be implemented with parameterization for dynamic source/target selection and governed using Data Factory’s native versioning and deployment features.

- **Data Cleansing and Transformation:** Within each pipeline, robust data validation, deduplication, and standardization routines will be enacted to improve data consistency and quality. Business logic transformations—including field mapping, type conversions, aggregation, and normalization—will be integrated to ensure the resulting data structures are optimized for analytics, reporting, or operational consumption.

- **Integrated Data Model:** Data from multiple sources will be consolidated into a harmonized schema, ready for downstream analytics, AI model training, or BI reporting. Where appropriate, Data Factory integration runtimes will be configured to ensure secure data movement between on-premises and cloud environments.

**Deliverables**

The outcome will be a suite of reliable, automated data ingestion and integration pipelines—fully documented, deployed, and instrumented for monitoring. These pipelines will enable the client to ingest and process both batch and streaming data efficiently, maintain high data quality standards, and rapidly deliver integrated data for critical business insight and innovation.
3.5 Data Quality and Validation:
To ensure the highest standards of data integrity throughout the lifecycle of the solution, we will implement a comprehensive Data Quality and Validation Framework tailored to your organization’s specific data landscape. Our approach encompasses methodical quality checks, robust validation rules, and proactive monitoring to support accurate and reliable data-driven processes.

First, we will establish a suite of automated data quality checks at key ingestion, transformation, and integration touchpoints. These checks will assess critical dimensions including completeness, validity, consistency, uniqueness, and timeliness, drawing upon your business rules and regulatory requirements as the baseline. For example, mandatory fields for core business entities such as customer records or transaction data will be verified for existence and format adherence before entering downstream systems.

We will collaborate with your data stewards to design custom validation rules that scrutinize data against established reference lists, value ranges, and inter-field dependencies—minimizing the risk of erroneous, conflicting, or out-of-bound values. Throughout ETL pipelines, we will deploy anomaly detection routines that flag unexpected trends or outliers based on historical and statistical baselines, ensuring data stays within expected operational thresholds.

To address duplicates and discrepancies, our framework includes the implementation of sophisticated matching algorithms and deduplication workflows. Leveraging both deterministic and probabilistic techniques, we will identify and resolve instances of repeating records—whether they arise from system integrations, user input errors, or batch imports. Discrepancies uncovered within or across data sources will be funneled into a resolution workflow, where data quality teams can triage, investigate, and rectify issues using streamlined user interfaces and audit trails.

Our solution further incorporates end-to-end data profiling and continuous monitoring. At deployment, we will conduct an initial data profiling assessment to establish baselines for quality metrics such as null rates, format violations, and distribution patterns. We will then configure ongoing monitoring, alerting designated personnel to emerging issues via dashboards and automated notifications. These capabilities will ensure that changes in data quality are detected early, allowing for timely intervention before they impact business operations or reporting.

All data quality activities—validation, anomaly detection, deduplication, profiling, and monitoring—will be orchestrated and centralized within the Data Quality and Validation Framework. This implementation will be fully documented, auditable, and designed for scalability, supporting both current and future data governance needs. By integrating our tailored framework, your organization will benefit from improved trust in your data assets, reduced operational risk, and a strong foundation for data-driven decision making.
3.6 Data Storage and Management:
**3.6 Data Storage and Management**

To ensure robust, scalable, and efficient data storage and management, our solution leverages the native capabilities of Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) for raw and curated data, and combines them with optimized data models and performance tuning in Azure Synapse Analytics.

**Azure Data Lake Storage Organization**

Data will be ingested and cataloged within a secure ADLS Gen2 environment, structured into clear zones that support data lifecycle management and security best practices:

- **Raw Zone:** Ingested source data is stored in its original format, ensuring data lineage, auditability, and reprocessing flexibility.
- **Curated Zone:** Cleansed, transformed, and business-aligned datasets are maintained here, ready for downstream analytics and reporting.
- **Sandbox/Workspace Zone:** A controlled area for experimentation, development, and data science exploration, isolated from production workloads.

Folder hierarchies and access policies will be defined following data domain, date (YYYY/MM/DD), and sensitivity, leveraging Azure RBAC and POSIX-compliant ACLs for granular access control. Metadata management is streamlined using Azure Data Catalog integration, enabling data discoverability and consistent governance.

**Optimized Data Storage in Azure Synapse Analytics**

To maximize analytical performance and cost efficiency, data migrated from the curated ADLS zone will be organized into dedicated and serverless pools within Synapse Analytics. Key optimization strategies include:

- **Table Design:** Star and snowflake schemas will be implemented based on business use cases, ensuring normalization where appropriate. Fact and dimension tables will be precisely structured to maximize query performance and minimize redundancy.
- **Indexing:** Columnstore indexes will be utilized for large fact tables to accelerate aggregations and reduce storage footprint. Where low-latency point lookups are needed, conventional clustered or non-clustered indexes will be added selectively, balancing update and query needs.
- **Partitioning:** Tables will be carefully partitioned—commonly by date or another high-cardinality attribute—to support efficient querying, incremental loads, and data lifecycle management. Partition elimination techniques will be applied to further enhance query performance.

By organizing data according to business context and implementing technical optimizations rooted in proven patterns, our approach delivers a storage and management foundation that is reliable, scalable, and cost-effective, supporting both current and evolving analytics requirements.

3.9 Testing and Quality Assurance:
To ensure the reliability, accuracy, and business alignment of the data platform, our approach to Testing and Quality Assurance is comprehensive and methodical, encompassing all critical layers of the solution lifecycle.

We will initiate the process with rigorous **unit testing** of all ETL scripts. Each transformation and data loading routine will be validated in isolation to guarantee that data is extracted, transformed, and loaded as intended, with all edge cases and data quality rules enforced. This granular testing will surface issues early, reducing downstream defects and rework.

Following unit testing, we will conduct **integration testing** across the ETL pipelines, data lake, and data warehouse components. This phase will verify that all subsystems interact seamlessly, ensuring that data flows smoothly from ingestion through to storage and analytical layers. We will simulate real-world data scenarios, including incremental loads and schema changes, to confirm end-to-end functionality and system robustness.

A critical aspect of our quality assurance is the **validation of data lake accuracy and completeness**. We will systematically compare data ingested into the data lake against the source systems, employing both automated reconciliation scripts and manual spot checks. This ensures that all records are accounted for, data fidelity is maintained, and no loss or corruption occurs during the ingestion process.

To ensure that the solution aligns with your business objectives, we will engage key stakeholders in **User Acceptance Testing (UAT)**. We will collaborate to define UAT scenarios that reflect actual business processes and reporting needs. Stakeholders will execute these scenarios, validating that the system meets functional requirements, delivers expected insights, and supports operational workflows.

Throughout this process, we will produce comprehensive **Test Plans** detailing the scope, objectives, methodologies, and acceptance criteria for each testing phase. Upon completion, we will deliver **Test Results** documentation, including defect logs, resolution status, and sign-off records. This transparent approach provides you with clear evidence of solution quality and readiness for production deployment.

We will employ robust data migration tools to transfer historical and incremental data, ensuring data integrity through checksum validation and reconciliation reports. Metadata, data catalogs, and access controls will also be migrated and validated to preserve lineage and security.

**Configuration and Validation:**  
System configurations—including connection strings, environment variables, and monitoring endpoints—will be tailored to the production context. Smoke tests and validation scripts will be executed to verify successful deployment of all components and the readiness of the analytics environment.

**Go-Live Monitoring and Support:**  
Immediately upon go-live, our team will activate enhanced monitoring and logging across the Data Lake Platform. Key performance indicators such as data ingestion rates, job completion times, query performance, and resource utilization will be closely tracked using integrated dashboards and alerting systems. A dedicated support team will be on standby to address any anomalies, performance degradations, or user concerns, ensuring rapid incident response and resolution.

**Issue Resolution and Continuous Improvement:**  
Any issues identified during the initial production period will be logged, triaged, and addressed according to predefined escalation procedures. Root cause analysis will be performed for critical incidents, with corrective actions implemented and documented. Feedback from business users and technical stakeholders will be solicited to guide post-deployment tuning and optimization.

**Deliverable:**  
Upon successful completion of deployment and stabilization activities, the fully operational Production Data Warehouse and Analytics Environment will be delivered. This environment will empower users with reliable, high-performance access to curated data, advanced analytics, and actionable insights, supporting the organization’s strategic objectives from day one.

4. Software Licenses:
Sidra Medicine’s existing investment in Microsoft Azure cloud services provides a robust, enterprise-grade foundation for the proposed solution. Our approach is to fully leverage the currently licensed software stack to deliver a seamless, cost-effective implementation, ensuring there are no unforeseen licensing expenditures.

The solution will be architected and developed exclusively using the following platforms already licensed and operational within Sidra Medicine’s Azure Qatar data center:

- **Azure Databricks**: This will serve as the primary environment for advanced data processing, collaborative analytics, and scalable data engineering workflows. All ETL, data transformation, and machine learning model development will be executed within Azure Databricks, ensuring high performance and security.

5. Timeline and Milestones::
Our approach to the project timeline and milestones is designed to ensure transparency, accountability, and timely delivery of all key activities and deliverables. We propose a structured project plan, grounded in Agile project management methodology, which allows for iterative development, early stakeholder feedback, and adaptive planning throughout the 10-month engagement.

**Month 1: Initiation and Foundational Design**  
The project will commence with an intensive requirements gathering and analysis phase, conducted in close collaboration with your stakeholders to ensure a comprehensive understanding of business objectives, technical needs, and compliance considerations. Concurrently, our solution architects will design the Data Lake/Data Lakehouse architecture, aligning with your existing infrastructure and future scalability requirements. This dual-track approach accelerates the transition to subsequent phases by establishing a clear technical and functional blueprint.

**Months 1–2: Infrastructure Setup**  
Immediately following architectural design approval, our engineering team will provision and configure the necessary cloud or on-premises infrastructure. This includes setting up secure networking, storage, and compute resources, as well as implementing foundational security controls. By completing infrastructure setup early, we enable parallel workstreams for data ingestion and integration.

**Months 1–5: Data Ingestion and Integration**  
With infrastructure in place, we will begin integrating data sources through both batch and real-time pipelines. Our team will prioritize high-value data streams, ensuring that critical business data is available early for downstream processing. We will employ robust ETL/ELT frameworks to ensure data quality, consistency, and traceability from the outset.

**Months 2–7: Data Processing and Transformation**  
As data ingestion scales, our data engineering specialists will implement processing and transformation logic to convert raw data into structured, analytics-ready formats. This phase will include the development of reusable transformation pipelines, data cleansing routines, and enrichment processes, all tailored to your organizational requirements.

**Months 2–8: Data Storage and Management**  
In tandem with processing, we will establish optimized data storage solutions, ensuring efficient access, scalability, and cost-effectiveness. Our approach will leverage tiered storage strategies and implement robust data cataloging for discoverability and governance.

**Months 3–9: Data Governance and Compliance**  
Recognizing the importance of data stewardship, we will introduce governance frameworks starting in Month 3. This includes defining data ownership, access controls, lineage tracking, and compliance mechanisms (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA as applicable). By integrating governance early and iteratively enhancing it, we minimize risk and ensure regulatory alignment.

**Months 7–9: Analytics, Reporting, Machine Learning, Testing, and Validation**  
Upon establishing a stable and governed data foundation, we will deploy analytics and reporting tools, and facilitate the setup of machine learning models tailored to your use cases. This period also encompasses comprehensive system testing and validation—covering functional, performance, and security dimensions—to ensure solution robustness and alignment with business objectives.

**Months 8–10: Documentation and Training**  
The final phase emphasizes knowledge transfer and sustainability. We will deliver detailed technical documentation and conduct targeted training sessions for your teams, empowering them to operate, maintain, and extend the solution post-deployment.

Throughout the project, our Agile methodology ensures frequent stakeholder engagement, regular progress reviews, and adaptive planning. We will provide a detailed Gantt chart and milestone tracking dashboard at project kickoff, with bi-weekly status updates and milestone reviews to proactively address risks and maintain alignment with your strategic goals. This disciplined, transparent approach guarantees on-time delivery and a solution that meets your current and future data needs.
